chunks: "He will be credited with the better and more complete of the two."

key_terms.أَتَمُّهُمَا: the more complete of the two
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or transmitted

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that a person is credited with the better and more complete of two prayers?
ai.summary: This report indicates that when two acts are under consideration, the reward is counted for the one that is superior and more complete. In the context of congregational prayer, it points to divine credit being based on the more excellent and perfected form of the act.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "He will be credited with the better and more complete of the two”.
